notes: Reduced GetBuildingListHandler class coupling from 13 (YELLOW) to 8 (GREEN) by removing the [FromServices] attribute (unnecessary in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs) and introducing a FromBuildings() factory method on GetBuildingListResponse that encapsulates the Building-to-BuildingDto mapping, eliminating the handler's direct dependency on BuildingMapper, BuildingDto, and IEnumerable. All 215 tests pass after refactoring.
